# Victoria Crest International School

> Victoria Crest International School (VCIS) is a school in Kumasi, Ashanti Region, Ghana, established in 2014. It is accredited by the Ghana Education Service (GES) and inspected by the National Schools Inspectorate Authority (NaSIA). It teaches Early Years (ages 2–5), Primary (ages 6–11) and Junior High (ages 12–14). Motto: Excellence. Integrity. Purpose.

## Key facts

- Name: Victoria Crest International School (also "Victoria Crest" or "VCIS Kumasi")
- Established: 2014
- Location: Victoria Crest Campus, Ahinsan Estate, Kumasi, Ashanti Region, Ghana
- Phone: 059 977 2383 (+233 59 977 2383) and 024 201 9659 (+233 24 201 9659)
- WhatsApp: +233 59 977 2383
- General email: info@vcis.com.gh
- Admissions email: admissions@vcis.com.gh
- Website: https://vcis.com.gh/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/victoriacrestinternationalschool
- Accreditation: Ghana Education Service (GES); National Schools Inspectorate Authority (NaSIA)

## Programmes

- [Early Years](https://vcis.com.gh/programmes/early-years): Ages 2–5 (KG1 to KG2). Play, language, early numeracy and independence.
- [Primary](https://vcis.com.gh/programmes/primary): Ages 6–11 (Primary 1 to Primary 6). Literacy, numeracy, science, technology and character formation.
- [Junior High](https://vcis.com.gh/programmes/junior-high): Ages 12–14 (JHS 1 to JHS 3). Subject mastery, critical thinking, leadership and examination readiness.
- [All programmes](https://vcis.com.gh/programmes): Overview of the three programme bands.

## Admissions

- [Admissions](https://vcis.com.gh/admissions): How to apply and an online application form.
- Steps: 1) Enquire by phone, WhatsApp or the online form. 2) Visit and apply with documents. 3) Confirm enrolment after placement.
- Online applications go to the school's admissions inbox for staff review. They do not enrol a child automatically.
- For current places and fees, call or message the school on WhatsApp.
